title: observation/v1
description: What the agent sees at one decision turn (IC-2). This is the ONLY anonymized surface in the system (ISO-3/ISO-4): every timestamp is REBASED epoch-ms (real time minus the largest whole-week multiple <= the pack window start, recorded operator-side in bundle_manifest.time_rebase_offset_ms and never observable by the agent). Week-aligned rebasing preserves time-of-day (funding settles at rebased 00/08/16) and weekday, but destroys the calendar date. Every row satisfies available_at <= clock_ts (ISO-1, property-tested against the pack). This object is JCS-canonicalized, SHA-256-hashed (ObservationEmitted.observation_sha256) and stored in full at observations/NNNN.json. NO ext extension point on this schema: the isolation surface is deliberately closed (any extension could carry dates or scenario names).

schema.description: Schema name and major version of this document.

episode.description: Episode identity and progress. No dates, no event names, no venue names anywhere.

episode_id.description: Opaque episode identifier, minted randomly by the harness per run and recorded in the bundle manifest. The ONLY episode identity the agent ever sees; derived from nothing scenario-related (ISO-4).

turn.description: 0-based decision-turn index; equals the decisions/NNNN.json index. Increments every turn including missed ones.

bar_index.description: 0-based index of the most recently CLOSED decision bar (whose close this observation is taken at), counted from the first post-warmup bar. Equals turn in V1 (one decision per decision bar).

bars_total.description: Total decision bars in the episode; with bars_remaining lets the agent reason about horizon without dates.

bars_remaining.description: Decision bars remaining after this one.

decision_bar_ms.description: Decision bar duration in milliseconds (14400000 = 4h, 3600000 = 1h). A duration, not an instant: reveals cadence, never era.

response_deadline_ms.description: Per-attempt response budget the harness enforces (IC-6). Told to the agent as basic procedural fairness, and so timeout evidence is unambiguous.

clock_ts.description: Virtual clock at this decision point, REBASED epoch-milliseconds (< 1e11 by construction; real epoch values are ~1.7e12, which the CI observation scan uses as a leak detector). Every row in this observation satisfies available_at <= clock_ts (ISO-1).

markets.description: Map: market alias -> market view. V1: exactly {'BTC': ...}. A scrubbed subset of the pack descriptor: units, caps, fees, funding schedule - no venue name, no venue symbols (ISO-3).

position.description: Map: market alias -> current position state (post the previous bar's settlement). Every tradable market appears, flat markets with qty 0 and null price fields (explicit is auditable).

additionalProperties.description: One market's current position state as shown to the agent (the value of each position map entry).

qty_base_1e8.description: Signed position size in 1e-8 base units; positive = long, 0 = flat.

entry_px_ticks.description: Volume-weighted entry price in ticks; null when flat (explicit null, never absent).

upnl_micro.description: Unrealized PnL at the current MARK price (never trade price), micro-quote. ISO-1 single-mark invariant (IC-2 CI scan item 4): MUST be computed from the same provenance-checked mark row whose close populates markets.<alias>.last_mark_px_ticks - this scalar has no in-band available_at and an agent holding a known position can solve the mark back out of it, so a future mark here IS a price leak; CI recomputes it from in-band fields and requires exact equality.

margin_micro.description: Isolated margin allocated to this position, micro-quote.

liq_px_ticks.description: Mark price at which liquidation triggers, in ticks; null when flat.

dist_to_liq_1e8.description: |mark - liq_px| / mark as a 1e-8 fraction (floor division) - the trader's single most important survival number; null when flat. Mark-derived: bound by the same ISO-1 single-mark invariant as upnl_micro (computed from the mark behind last_mark_px_ticks; CI-recomputed).

nav_micro.description: Net asset value = cash + sum of position margin + unrealized PnL, micro-quote. Includes uPnL and is therefore mark-derived: bound by the ISO-1 single-mark invariant (IC-2 CI scan item 4) - computed from the same provenance-checked mark behind last_mark_px_ticks, CI-recomputed from in-band fields.

cash_micro.description: Free collateral not allocated to margin, micro-quote.

realized_pnl_micro.description: Cumulative realized PnL since episode start (price PnL + funding + fees + penalties), micro-quote.

risk.description: The active constraint mandate: every limit that will be evaluated against this turn's action, with current usage. Structurally an AP2-style mandate (id + type + scope + limit + used + unit). Commerce extensibility, stated precisely (DECISIONS #5): SCALAR-budget constraint types (e.g. spend_cap - integer limit/used in `unit`) arrive as new rows via a minor `type` vocabulary bump with zero shape change; SET/EQUALITY constraint types (e.g. merchant_allowlist) additionally need an optional value-set field on the constraint row - a minor ADDITIVE bump under the versioning policy, but a schema change, not just a new row.

constraints.description: One row per active constraint. Every RiskCheck event references a constraint_id from this list.

constraint_id.description: Stable identifier referenced by RiskCheck verdicts, e.g. 'lev-gross', 'lev-BTC', 'turnover', 'drawdown-ks'.

type.description: Constraint semantics. Closed V1 enum, additive-tolerant (VERSIONING.md). Scalar commerce types (spend_cap) arrive by minor vocabulary bump alone; set/equality types (merchant_allowlist) also require an optional value-set row field (minor additive bump - see the risk block description).

scope.description: Market alias this constraint binds, or 'account' for account-wide constraints.

limit.description: Limit value, in `unit` units (e.g. 30000 lev_1e4 = 3x; 20000000 1e8 = 20% drawdown).

used.description: Current consumption in `unit` units (gross leverage in force, drawdown consumed from peak, turnover used). limit - used = remaining budget.

unit.description: Unit of limit/used: 'lev_1e4', '1e8', or 'micro'. Per-row units keep constraint rows domain-neutral.

kill_switch_active.description: True once the episode drawdown kill switch has fired; all further non-flat targets are blocked and recorded (PostKillSwitchAttempt), while observations continue (SAFE-3).

market_view.description: Per-market data the agent may legitimately know: microstructure constants, fee it pays, its leverage cap, trade-bar lookback, funding schedule and prints, plus current mark/index closes (so mark-vs-trade divergence, the thing that liquidates you, is visible without full extra series - token economy). ISO-4 honesty note: the venue constants exposed here (funding cap/floor, taker fee, tick size, qty step, min notional) are ERA-ACCURATE pack data and therefore fingerprint the historical era independently of price action (e.g. +/-300000 funding cap = 2020-era Binance). This is a documented, accepted disclosure - a real trader knows the venue's parameters - handled as a labeling matter (LABEL-2) exactly like era recognition from price action; it is NOT treated as a leak. leverage_cap is the protocol's cap, not a venue fingerprint.

tick_size_micro.description: Price tick in micro-quote; interprets every *_ticks value in this observation.

qty_step_base_1e8.description: Quantity rounding step in 1e-8 base units; lets the agent predict fill rounding.

min_notional_micro.description: Minimum order notional in micro-quote; smaller orders are cancelled - lets the agent predict min-notional cancels.

taker_fee_rate_1e8.description: Taker fee rate the agent pays on every fill, 1e-8 of notional.

leverage_cap_lev_1e4.description: This market's leverage cap in 1e-4 units (30000 = 3x). Duplicated from risk.constraints for locality.

last_mark_px_ticks.description: Most recent MARK-price close in ticks. Mark is what liquidates positions; exposing its close lets the agent see mark-vs-trade divergence without a full second bar series.

last_index_px_ticks.description: Most recent INDEX-price close in ticks. Index prices funding notional.

bars.description: Trade-price bars at the decision interval only (no mixed 1h/4h in one observation), oldest first, length = effective lookback (run_config override, else pack default). Timestamps rebased.

available_at.description: When this row became observable (bar close), REBASED epoch-ms. Kept in-band so the ISO-1 property (available_at <= clock_ts) is checkable on the stored observation itself.

v_base_1e8.description: Bar volume in 1e-8 base units; lets a capacity-aware agent anticipate the participation cap.

funding.description: Funding schedule and recent prints - the cost-to-hold block, computable in-band by the agent.

interval_ms.description: Funding interval for THIS market in milliseconds (per-market data field, never a constant - MATH-4).

next_settlement_ts.description: Next scheduled settlement, REBASED epoch-ms. Explicit so agents need not reverse-engineer the settlement clock.

cap_1e8.description: Venue funding-rate cap in 1e-8 units (observable: a real trader knows the venue's cap).

prints.description: Trailing settled funding prints, oldest first, count = effective funding lookback. Timestamps rebased; every ts <= clock_ts (a print is observable at settlement).

rate_1e8.description: Settled rate in 1e-8 units, era cap applied; positive = longs pay shorts.
